selectorPolicy.flags: Python re.UNICODE default; no normalization or case folding.
selectorPolicy.textBoundary: Lex each exact fragment.text independently; preserve whitespace runs and each punctuation codepoint. Ordered matches partition the complete Unicode string with no gaps. Retain match.start/end codepoint offsets privately.
selectorPolicy.selector: Exactly three type-int values [zero-based fragment ordinal,zero-based first token ordinal,exclusive end token ordinal]. Require0<=fragment<len(evidence),0<=first<end<=len(tokens). A selector expands text from matches[first].start() to matches[end-1].end(), preserving every internal/outer selected character.
selectorPolicy.citation: Expand the selected quote with that fragment original key,source hash/method/locator retained outside model prompt. All model selected literals/units must be supported by their own expanded citations under unchanged original validation.
selectorPolicy.modelInput: Only source-derived fragment ordinals and ordered lexical token strings (including original whitespace/punctuation); no teacher targets/explanations/expected labels or canonical IDs. Preserve original input/provenance in artifacts; no new source extraction.
selectorPolicy.modelOutput: evidence-association-selectors/1; same claims/roles/states/decision codes/array order as legacy output, but literal/unit are selectors or null and citations are selector arrays. canonicalLinks remains empty.
selectorPolicy.projection: Strict raw JSON/schema/type/range checks precede deterministic expansion to evidence-association-output/1. Then run the unchanged original semantic/citation/state/family validator. Reject the entire response on any failure; preserve raw pointers/errors. Distinguish selector syntax validity,expanded output validity and accepted claim credit.
selectorPolicy.nondeclaredStates: Keep unknown,absent,null,withheld and conflicting distinct. Unknown/absent/null/withheld require null literal/unit; do not fabricate a state or quote to cover missing evidence. Conflict and abstention codes/citations remain model decisions,not automatically filled from teacher truth.
selectorPolicy.qualification: Exact spans ensure copied characters originate in evidence; they do not prove semantic role/state/correctness,ownership,canonical identity or generalization.

speed: Default/standard required; tool has no per-turn tier field. Verify supplied never/danger-full-access and report observed settings honestly.
reason: Both fixed full-JSON candidates fail development;132-update candidate invents quotations and breaks JSON. Copying evidence spans deterministically removes free-form literal/citation generation from the task without changing originals or relaxing semantic validation.
purpose: Build the source-span selector codec/strict projection and a separate prompt/interface for one later contained pretrained baseline. This is CPU preparation,not another full-JSON fit or a repaired historical output.
implementation: Implement a new leaf selectors.py and small targeted codec checks. Build lossless lexical views from existing input evidence,strictly decode the new selector output,then invoke unchanged original validation. Retain raw pointer output,expanded values and rejection errors with honest separate denominators.

Define one compact versioned selector prompt using the published roles/states and public native-field rules already available. Do not copy teacher targets/explanations or independent expectations into inference. Model literals/quotes must be source selectors,not free text. Preserve both old full-JSON prompts/functions and all old runs unchanged.

Prepare a narrow explicit later baseline route through the existing allowed association_student.py run entry point and fresh immutable profile/input/prompt/schema freeze if needed. Use existing containment actions/CLI allowlists; no shared security/resource/dependency changes. Actual staging/model invocation requires a separately reviewed/frozen assignment.

Use retained train examples for CPU round-trip/projection controls; do not assemble a second teacher dataset or require the pending teacher result. Include Haryana multi-floor/citation binding and Bihar unknown/null semantic preservation. Range/type/key/quote/source/state errors must reject whole outputs,with no partial accepted credit or fabricated repairs.

Do not modify or expand the LoRA fit chain now. A selector baseline and any later fitted candidate need new frozen task/provenance and their own measured quality result. Same model checkpoint/resources are retained for later execution.
verification: CPU-only syntax/codec/type/range/source-integrity checks and compile the owned delta. Review model-input target isolation and historical path preservation. No exhaustive matrices,teacher assembly,model dependency imports or original baseline/candidate reruns.
ownership: New selector leaf code/tests and necessary narrow existing association_student/staging dispatch,plus one small student handoff. Teacher exclusively owns target data/compiler. Coordinator schema/assignments/freeze/status,old fit/student runtime implementations,shared model_isolation/resources/security/dependencies,staging/frontend/services/gateway remain read-only except the named narrow baseline dispatch.
continuation: Return exact owned code/handoff commits,commands/exits,codec/prompt hash and later freeze contract,then callback only to coordinator and stop. No stage/model run,fit,reload,development/evaluation execution or promotion until both preparation results are inspected and a new assignment frozen.
